segments.an3.18:1.1: “Sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.an3.18:1.3: Nanu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ puṭṭhā aṭṭīyeyyātha harāyeyyātha jiguccheyyāthā”ti?
segments.an3.18:1.5: “Iti kira tumhe, bhikkhave, dibbena āyunā aṭṭīyatha harāyatha jigucchatha, dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbenādhipateyyena aṭṭīyatha harāyatha jigucchatha;
segments.an3.18:1.6: pageva kho pana, bhikkhave, tumhehi kāyaduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbaṃ, vacīduccaritena … manoduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabban”ti.

lines: Jiguccheyyāthāti gūthe viya tasmiṃ vacane sañjātajigucchā bhaveyyātha.
Dibbena kira āyunā aṭṭīyathāti evamassa sambandho veditabbo.
Aṭṭhame itīti padasandhibyañjanasiliṭṭhatāti purimapadānaṃ pacchimapadehi atthato sahitatāya byañjanānaṃ vākyānaṃ siliṭṭhatāya dīpane nipāto.
